mapper.select: SELECT id, verification_id AS verificationId, request_hash AS requestHash, response_json AS responseJson, model, prompt_tokens AS promptTokens, completion_tokens AS completionTokens, total_tokens AS totalTokens, DATE_FORMAT(reg_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS regDt, DATE_FORMAT(upd_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updDt FROM ai_analysis_result WHERE verification_id = #{verificationId} AND request_hash = #{requestHash} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, verification_id AS verificationId, request_hash AS requestHash, response_json AS responseJson, model, prompt_tokens AS promptTokens, completion_tokens AS completionTokens, total_tokens AS totalTokens, DATE_FORMAT(reg_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS regDt, DATE_FORMAT(upd_dt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updDt FROM ai_analysis_result WHERE verification_id = #{verificationId} ORDER BY upd_dt DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_analysis_result ( verification_id, request_hash, response_json, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens ) VALUES ( #{verificationId}, #{requestHash}, #{responseJson}, #{model}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE response_json = VALUES(response_json), model = VALUES(model), prompt_tokens = VALUES(prompt_tokens), completion_tokens = VALUES(completion_tokens), total_tokens = VALUES(total_tokens), upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
